normalize_tex: normalize a TeX math expression by stripping delimiters, removing line breaks, replacing synonyms, and removing style commands
unicode_to_latex: convert a Unicode string to LaTeX by encoding non-ASCII characters, handling umlauts, and replacing duplicate definitions
remove_style: remove LaTeX style commands like displaystyle, scriptstyle, scriptscriptstyle, and textstyle from a string
replace_duplicate_definitions: replace interchangeable LaTeX commands with their canonical equivalents using a predefined synonym list
remove_line_breaks: remove LaTeX comments and line breaks from a string by replacing them with spaces
